candidate.title: The Power of Chain of Thought Reasoning in LLMs
candidate.description:
Talk from the largest practical AI community in the world on Mindstone here: https://buff.ly/3RyXDnK 

"The most crucial aspect here is what is known as chain of thought reasoning. Essentially, I request the model to outline its own thought process before providing me with an answer. This point holds more significance than you might initially realize because of the way these models operate. They constantly predict the next token, word, or letter that will be generated. Therefore, when asking the model to outline its own thinking, the text it produces about its reasoning becomes part of the original prompt. This means that the answer will be much more useful, as if you had initially written that piece of reasoning and then asked the model to answer. Consequently, it provides better contextual information. I will now activate these customized instructions."
